note: Adapted from the species description of Emerson (1959), originally in English; only the soldier and the worker are described, there being no alate; measurements are those of the holotype table; synonymic references, distribution records and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The most reliable distinction from H. laticeps is the flatter postmentum in lateral view; the ratio of the narrowest to the greatest postmental width is larger (the greatest width being relatively narrower in H. laticeps), the posterior constriction is less abrupt, and the lateral margins are concave over a longer extent. The soldier head is slightly larger than in H. laticeps in most measurements, with the sides more convex and less straight; the mandibles are stouter and slightly less curved, with the dentition and the base sharper, stouter and more distinct. Setae, labrum, pronotal shape and tibial spurs are similar in the two sexes; the processes on the ridge of the fore coxa are also similar, but vary among individuals of the same colony.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and the sclerotized parts of the thorax and abdomen yellowish brown. Head with scattered rather long setae, a few microscopic hairs around the glandular pore. Pronotum and tergites with scattered long setae and a few short setae. Inner face of the convex surface and the process of the fore coxa with a few scattered setae. Sternites with numerous long setae and some short setae. Head subsquare, thick and stout, sides slightly convex, posterior margin rounded; in lateral view thick, dorsal margin fairly straight, posterior margin rounded. Antennal sockets situated in small lateral depressions, without sharp ridges nearby. Frontal gland evident, visible beneath the surface of the head capsule, the glandular pore small with a distinct opening. Sides of the postmentum slightly flattened near the margin at the greatest width; in lateral view fairly uniformly flatly convex, not bulbous. Antennae 14-segmented, 3rd segment shorter than the 4th, 4th shorter than the 2nd. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum with a deep notch between the anterior and lateral margins; anterior margin evenly convex, without a median notch. Fore coxal ridge with a concave surface on the inner side near the tooth, passing gradually into an inner convex surface. Holotype: head length including mandibles 4.76 mm, head width 2.59 mm, postmentum length 1.82 mm, pronotum width 1.77 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head with scattered long and short setae. Antennae 14-segmented. Mandibles almost identical with those of H. laticeps. Anterior margin of the pronotum without any trace of a notch. Fore coxa as in the genus.
